text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sometime around the middle of February, as I walk by the station with King Halo…

text_block_list.name: High School Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, look! Is that the Umamusume everyone's been talking about? Is that King?

text_block_list.name: High School Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Are you serious?! I heard she'll take a picture with us if we ask. I wonder if it's true.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! That depends entirely on my mood!

text_block_list.name: High School Students
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You needn't be so surprised. Especially not after I took the trouble to address you in the first place.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Excuse you! Since when have I been your anything?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Well? Didn't you two mention wanting a picture a moment ago?

text_block_list.name: High School Students
text_block_list.text: Um, ah… Yes…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Right. Then I grant you the right to have your picture taken with me. Tag the image with "King is the best" and "Takamatsunomiya Kinen," won't you?

text_block_list.name: High School Students
text_block_list.text: Really? Are you sure you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, of course not. Your king is both generous and merciful!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Now, isn't this a photo you'll remember for the rest of your lives?

text_block_list.name: High School Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, yes! It's adorbs! Thanks, King!

text_block_list.name: High School Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Please, take this friendship chocolate as a thank you gift! We've got some for you too, mister!

text_block_list.name: High School Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Please, take this friendship chocolate as a thank you gift! We've got some for you too, miss!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: For me? Th…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Th-thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swept up in the moment, I also receive some friendship chocolate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Friendship chocolate… Hehe. A couple of fans just gave me some friendship chocolate.
choice_data_list: Yeah, they seemed to really like you.
Yeah, they seemed to really like you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well of course. Why wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If I keep this up and boost my popularity, then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Loud Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: Yesss! I got the pic! I can already see the headline for this juicy scoop—"Social Media Slave? The Shallow Musings of a Wannabe Celeb!"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Passerby
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that the legendary Umamusume socialite? They spoke about her on the talk show the other day…

text_block_list.name: Woman with Child
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, the one who caused a big fuss when she suddenly changed her goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Drawn in by the paparazzi, the passersby shoot dubious looks our way. King Halo, however…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Excuse me, Miss Paparazzi. Wait a moment, please.

text_block_list.name: Loud Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: What? You want copy approval or something? You can wait until the article is published like everyone el—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, that's all right. You're welcome to criticize my behavior. I do use media people like you to benefit myself, after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But you're absolutely not welcome to use the photo you just took.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If your article ends up causing trouble for those girls who gave me chocolate… Well, let's just say I won't let you off lightly.

text_block_list.name: Loud Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: Gulp…
choice_data_list: I'd like a word with you too.

text_block_list.name: Loud Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the time we get back to the academy after settling things with the paparazzi, it's already dusk.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Trainer Presses Paparazzi!" "Who Is the Figure behind the Famous Young Socialite?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "The Value of King’s Choices to Be Tested at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm prepared to hear all sorts of opinions expressed about my behavior, but…
choice_data_list: You were happy getting that friendship chocolate from your fans.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What? W-well, that's…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Of course I was happy. I mean, they were expressing their fondness for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Why am I so awkward?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Today was tiring for both of us, wasn't it? But at least we got some sweets out of it. Let's have some tea.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I hereby give you the right to prepare some exquisite tea for yours truly. Chop chop, now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I brew some tea for King Halo, and the tension seems to melt from her face as she savors the chocolate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Of course I'm happy. I mean, they were expressing their fondness for me.
choice_data_list: Then ignore all the other voices. Just listen to your fans.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …I know that, dummy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But yes. I'll do them the honor of treasuring such gestures.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And I shall also do my closest fan the honor of gratefully acknowledging their commitment.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Even so, today was exhausting. But seeing as we've been given something sweet, let's have some tea.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Today, I will grant you the right to drink some tea that I have brewed myself. Do savor its exquisite taste.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even as King Halo prepares the tea, I catch her glancing at the chocolate from time to time and smiling.
